svg.title: @hxp-tools Overworld Map
svg.desc: Playable overworld campaign map for 14 @hxp-tools packages across 8 worlds: W7 Brief (pillars), W1 God (godpowers, godplans, goddesign, godaudits), W2 Proof (mythify), W3 DNA (codedna, docdna), W4 Audit (auditor-suite), W5 Voice (authenticity-check, humanizer, voiceprint), W8 Arc (ready-suite), and side campaign W6 Ink (scriveno).
svg.text: SECTOR B // MATCH DNA, AUDIT & VOICE
